tells.3: Bold benefit labels on every bullet in a rigid parallel template.
tells.4: The same label-colon skeleton on every item, even with a looser voice.
tells.5: Lockstep bold labels, clipped parallel bullets, and a fix restated only as a benefit.

reason: Version 1 is what a careful editor would ship: clear, credible, and free of both draft errors and generated template tics. Versions 3 and 5 read assembled from the same label-plus-blurb pattern, while 2 is human but unskilled.
